{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|I found it years ago. When I was no older than you are now. I found it in the River of Light on my home planet.|Qui-Gon Jinn, handing Obi-Wan Kenobi a Force-sensitive stone|<ref name="THP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]''</ref>}}
A type of '''stone''' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was found on the [[Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Jinn kept [[River stone|one]] such stone as a memento, eventually passing it to his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="THP" /> who in turn handed the stone to his apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TWOTA">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref> Shiny black in [[Color/Legends|color]], the stone had veins of deep red visible when viewed in bright light. It was warm to the touch and emitted a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] glow in the dark that brought warmth and serenity.<ref name="THP" />
